goal: Make risk acceptance and continuous control validation real: approval chain CISO→CRO→CLO→Board with time-bound expiry, and evidence-vs-attestation drift for MFA + 4 other controls.
definition_of_done: Exception entity exists with state machine: pending → approved → expired (or denied).
Approval chain enforces order: CISO ack → CRO ack → CLO ack → Board ack; skipping → 400.
Time-bound expiry: cron job moves approved exceptions past expiryDate → expired daily.
Drift detection: when external validation diverges from attestation >5% on MFA, EDR, patch%, MTTR, phishing% → drift flag raised + risk re-scored.
Audit evidence repository links evidence files to controls and audit tests.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Exception schema: id, controlId, riskId, requestedBy, justification, approvalChain[], status, expiryDate, conditions[]
Request form posts to POST /api/exceptions; validation rejects empty justification + missing expiry
Approval chain enforces CISO → CRO → CLO → Board order via state transitions
Approver role check: a CLO cannot ack as a CRO; returns 403
Auto-expiry cron job processes expired exceptions daily; idempotent
Exception tracking dashboard at /exceptions: queue view, status, days-to-expiry
Risk register integration: an approved exception annotates the related Risk with status='accepted' + expiryDate
Drift detection runs for MFA, EDR, patch%, MTTR, phishing% on a daily schedule
Drift threshold (>5% absolute divergence) raises a drift_flag and lowers the control_effectiveness_score
Audit evidence repository: POST /api/audit/evidence/:controlId attaches files; auditor view lists evidence per control
Management assertion validation: control test result flips to 'unsubstantiated' when evidence is missing or drifted

must_read.reason: Risk register is rendered here; exception status badge adds onto its rows
Existing scheduler pattern for daily/weekly metric syncs; drift detection runs the same way
Real-tool sync values (Okta MFA, CrowdStrike EDR, Tenable patch, etc.) — drift compares these to attested values

tasks.title: Approval chain state machine: CISO → CRO → CLO → Board with role enforcement
Daily cron: auto-expire exceptions past expiryDate
Drift detection service: daily compare external sync to attested values for MFA/EDR/patch/MTTR/phishing

must_read.reason: Sync values for these 5 metrics already implemented

tasks.title: Re-score Risk and annotate with exception state when applicable
Audit evidence repository: link evidence to controls; auditor view
Management assertion validation: 'unsubstantiated' when evidence missing/drifted

validator_team_checks.acceptance: Every ACC-05-* has an automated test in artifact_paths.
validator_team_checks.security: Approval-chain bypass attempts return 403; exception creation requires authenticated session.
validator_team_checks.no_regression: Risk register continues to render unchanged for risks without exceptions.
validator_team_checks.integration: End-to-end: create exception → CISO ack → CRO ack → CLO ack → Board ack → status='approved'; cron after expiry → status='expired'.

risks.risk: Board ack lacks an authentication path
risks.mitigation: Board user role added in Month 4 auth; board ack via signed email link as backup, with audit log

risks.risk: Drift detection false-positives erode trust in metrics
risks.mitigation: Hysteresis: require 3 consecutive days >5% before flagging; per-metric tuning
Email notification 14/7/1 days before expiry to all approvers

stop_conditions: Any change that allows an exception to skip an approver without explicit Board override + audit log.
Disabling drift detection in prod for any reason — must be PR'd and reviewed.
